notes.title: adjustments
notes.notes:
Hope everyone is enjoying th egame. I have made some adjustments including:

[list]
[*] Easier to see through Censored font to help people see and navigate menu.
[*] explosive blast does slightly more damage at the start of blast.
[*] speed up item lasts longer now.
[*] Hologram now can take additional damage.
[*] Additional text when you are able to purchase extra lives explaining you must press action button.
[/list]

Please leave a review if you enjoy the game as it helps with the algorithim.

Thank you for your support !
